verdict.line: You lose if you let him sit on Burning Agony and poke cleavers for free; you win by forcing all-ins before 6 and finishing fast.

brief.thesis: Dr. Mundo has no hard CC and no gap-closer, so Riven's stun and burst are structurally safe to throw — the fight is decided by whether you can kill him inside one or two Ki Burst windows before Adrenaline Rush and Burning Agony heal him back to full. This is a true all-in lane: 53.1% over 81 games says Riven wins it, and the kill pressure is yours.

theirWindow.when: he's topped up, W toggled on
theirWindow.what: Burning Agony ticks 1s cooldown as long as he holds it, bleeding his own HP to shred disable duration and chip you — don't facetank it, back out of the 325 range and reset instead of trading into a free damage aura.

yourWindow.when: he's below 50% HP, E (Masochism) just procced
yourWindow.what: His missing-health AD buff from E looks scary but it doesn't heal him — if you can land W (Ki Burst) to stun through it and chain Q (Broken Wings) charges, he can't out-regen a full combo before Adrenaline Rush catches up. Commit here, not when he's full HP.

boots.why: 53.2% win rate over 62 games — the ability haste shortens your W stun and E block cooldowns, which is what actually wins the all-in since Mundo has no CC to punish you for being aggressive.

runes.keystoneWhy: stacking Conqueror in extended trades directly counters his max-health regen — it's the only way your sustained damage output keeps pace with Adrenaline Rush over a 5-second fight.

summoners.why: run at 51.5% win rate with a 97.1% pick rate — Ignite's execute and healing reduction is close to mandatory against a champion whose entire kit is regenerating health.

playing.title: Poke with Q before level 6
playing.detail: Broken Wings' 275 range lets you charge Runic Blade stacks and chip him down before his cleaver sustain snowballs, without needing to commit E.

playing.title: Save W for his approach, not yours
playing.detail: Ki Burst's 260-range stun is your only hard CC in the fight — hold it until he's already within 260 units so he can't just walk away after it lands.

playing.title: Block cleavers with E, not autos
playing.detail: Valor's damage block is tailor-made for Infected Cleaver's max-HP-based damage; step into it on cooldown (10/9/8/7/6s) to deny his main poke tool for free.

playing.title: All-in on cooldown windows, not HP thresholds
playing.detail: Because he has no stun, dash, or slow, your all-in risk is almost entirely about your own cooldowns — commit when Q and W are both up, not just when he looks low.

playing.title: Use R to close kills, not start them
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile's Wind Slash threatens from 200 range after he's already low — pop R mid-combo once Ki Burst has landed, not as your opener, since he can't punish the cast window anyway.

playing.title: Don't trade into active Burning Agony
playing.detail: The W toggle deals continual damage in 325 range while he holds it — walking into melee range during that window is a losing damage race until you're ready to all-in.

playing.title: Track Masochism's timer, not his HP bar
playing.detail: E's missing-health AD scaling means he hits hardest when low — don't assume low HP means he's safe to engage without respecting that temporary damage spike.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the matchup reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own tactical read, not sourced data.
